title: Coverage by Model
heading: Coverage by model
description: How far the project has read each SmartClock receiver's firmware, a row per image: its SCPI tree, pForth words, GPS engine, chip selects, loop constants, rewritten C, FPGA design and daemon support.
intro: What the project has done for each firmware image, a row per image and a column per kind of work, and a row for the 59551A, of which no image is available. A Yes links to the work; a cell that is not a Yes is checked to have nothing behind it in the repository, so the table cannot claim more than is there, or less.
legend: done and in the repository; the cell links to it

columns.heading: SCPI tree
columns.about: the command tree `smartclock-cli dump-scpi` reads out of the image ([[docs/scpi/README.md]]), and set side by side on the [SCPI trees by model](scpi-models.html)

columns.heading: pForth words
columns.about: the console's words, each with its code address, flags and stack effect ([[docs/firmware/pforth/README.md]]), and side by side on the [pForth words by model](pforth-models.html)

columns.heading: GPS engine
columns.about: which GPS engines the image accepts, the cell linked to the table of them ([[docs/firmware/gps.md|Which engines each image accepts]]): an Oncore VP, or in the 58503B and the Z3816A a VP or a UT Plus, in its binary `@@` messages, whose message table, request scripts and polling lists `smartclock-cli dump-oncore` reads ([[docs/firmware/oncore/README.md]]); or, in the Z3815A, a Furuno GT-74, in NMEA framing with Furuno's own `$PFEC` sentences ([[docs/firmware/gps.md|In every image]])

columns.heading: Chip selects
columns.about: the address map the boot code and the primary write to the processor's chip selects ([[docs/firmware/chip-selects.md]])

columns.heading: Loop constants
columns.about: the disciplining loop's constants read out of the image, kept in `docs/firmware/loop-constants.json` and tabled in [[docs/firmware/loop.md|In every image]] and on [the loop](loop.html)

columns.heading: Rewritten C
columns.about: every C function of the image written again by hand and checked against the image's own, function by function, in CI ([[README.md|The firmware]])

columns.heading: FPGA design
columns.about: which of the FPGA designs the image loads, its bitstream copied out of the image ([[docs/firmware/fpga-comparison.md]]), linked to its [detailed diagrams](fpga-detail.html)

columns.heading: FPGA decoded
columns.about: the design decoded from its bitstream, simulated and traced, its trace linked; the designs are illustrated on [the FPGA explainer](fpga.html)

columns.heading: Daemon support
columns.about: the dialect the daemon and its clients speak to the model, chosen from its `*IDN?` ([[crates/smartclock/src/device.rs]]), and for the Z3817A that its command lists are audited against a receiver (`complete` in [[crates/smartclock/commands.toml]]); [[README.md|The hardware]] says which models have been tested on a bench

footnotes.text: The daemon chooses the Z3801A's dialect for any Z3805A, but has not been tried with this firmware.

notes: The 58503A and the Z3801A load the same FPGA design ([[docs/firmware/outputs.md|The FPGA bitstreams]]).
